# Ramble

> Voice capture app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Record your thoughts on the go, get accurate transcripts, and pipe them into your agent, workflow, or automation via webhook. Open source, private by design, no accounts.

Ramble auto-POSTs every transcript to any HTTPS endpoint you configure. Works out of the box with Zapier, Make, Airtable, and n8n — or build your own endpoint.

## Docs

- [Webhook API — Full Reference](https://goodloop.dev/ramble/llms-full.txt): Complete webhook setup including automation platform guides, payload format, signature verification, and code examples.
